prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to sync your adopted pet securely to the cloud."]
1: ["Upload Your Pet Photo", "Use a clear, well-lit single-subject photo for best generation results.", "Select Pet Photo", "Photo Quality Check"]
2: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Review controls below before entering your desktop workspace."]
3: ["Checking desktop window overlay compatibility..."]
4: ["Log in with your existing account to instantly restore your active pets and custom settings.", "Your pet progress is saved automatically when signed in."]
5: ["How Would You Like to Get Started?", "Pick a ready-made companion or build your own custom desktop pet.", "Select Path"]
6: ["Desktop Pet Tips"]
7: ["Upload a Clear, Front-Facing Pet Photo", "For best results, choose a well-lit photo showing your pet's full face without background clutter.", "Avoid blurry photos, group shots, or dark lighting for accurate custom pet creation."]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion!", "Click your pet on the desktop to wake it up!"]
9: ["Recommended: Pick a starter pet in under 1 minute"]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency with a time constraint
